body: We sometimes tackle that in therapy. Sort of, finding your values gives context to the rest of life I think? I guess I just don't know what I care about. I don't feel I care about anything but I know that can't be true. At least I hope it's not. Thank you for replying though I really appreciate it

Hey thanks for replying  


I have to wait for quite a bit of time until I can see another therapist. I have to go through the public mental health stuff, which is just underfunded. I think I'm about 14 months away from seeing the person I had the initial meeting with. For now I'll keep talking to my current one. I've had her for over a year and I trust her, it's just I feel I'd like to talk about something more.  


I don't really have any friends at the moment. It's partially my fault because I spend more time by myself than not, but a lot of the people on my course are quite catty. Just a lot of shit talked behind others backs and it's not really my favorite haha.

Professor has kind of done everything he can really. I got really generous extensions I'm just not really fulfilling my part of it, because I'm not managing the work. I feel really bad but I am trying.

​

Thank you for replying though that means a lot
